levels.surface: الحسن بن أحمد بن أبي شعيب الحراني

notes: «مولى أم هانئ» describes باذان and is not part of the name. Tamim is the last link: the saying («برئ منها الناس غيري») is his. Al-Tirmidhi's own remarks identifying Abu al-Nadr and the other names are commentary, not links, and are left out (rule 9).
